staffing_plan.notes: Owns T1, T15, T23, T25, T26, T29, T30. Must be named decision-maker for sprint backlog refinement (R4 mitigation). 12.7% allocation within 10-15% PM oversight rule (600 total project hours). Full-time availability required for critical path tasks.

Owns T3, T6, T8, T10, T11, T12, T13, T16, T17, T18, T20, T21, T27. Critical path backbone for all integrations and backend logic. 38.7% allocation reflects high criticality but below 80% cap. Must have dedicated focus; R9 mitigation requires written commitment for 80% minimum allocation across 24 weeks. Backup required for projects >3 months (24 weeks).

Owns T7, T9, T14, T24. Front-loaded in Phases 1-2 (T7, T9, T14 on critical path); Phase 4 accessibility work (T24) has 2-day slack. 16.7% allocation. R12 mitigation: confirm React + TypeScript experience before Phase 2; allocate 1-week proof-of-concept spike. Backup required for 24-week project.

Owns T2, T4. Front-loaded in Phase 1 (T2 critical path, T4 has 3-day slack). 6.0% allocation. R15 mitigation: confirm 60% allocation for Phase 1-2; establish design review process with HR stakeholder. Phase 2 frontend development (T7, T9, T14) requires UX Designer collaboration for design feedback and iteration.

Owns T19, T22, T28. Phase 3-4 heavy (T19, T22 critical path); Phase 5 smoke testing (T28 has 1-day slack). 16.0% allocation. QA effort = 96h; total dev effort (Backend + Frontend) = 332h; QA ratio = 28.9% > 25% minimum (PMBOK 8.2). Meets hard rule. Critical path involvement in Phase 3-4 testing validates all integrations and edge cases (R13 mitigation).

open_questions.question: Who is the named Product Owner responsible for sprint-level backlog prioritization and scope decisions during Phase 2-3 execution?
open_questions.impact_if_unanswered: Hybrid SDLC requires single decision-maker for sprint planning; absence creates bottleneck and delays sprint kickoff (R4 trigger). PM cannot serve as both PM and PO at 12.7% allocation.

open_questions.question: Is Workday API sandbox access and production documentation already provisioned to the development team, or must this be requested before Phase 2?
open_questions.impact_if_unanswered: If API access is not yet provisioned, Phase 2 integration (T8, T6) is blocked; timeline risk of 2-4 weeks (R1 trigger). Backend Developer cannot begin T3 architecture design without API contract.

open_questions.question: Which e-signature service provider is approved and contracted (DocuSign, Adobe Sign, etc.), and is integration documentation available?
open_questions.impact_if_unanswered: If provider is not yet selected or contracted, procurement delay blocks UC2 (T11) and extends Phase 2 by 2-3 weeks (R2 trigger). Backend Developer cannot begin T11 implementation without API documentation.

open_questions.question: What is the complete scope of IT account provisioning automation (UC4)? Which SaaS tools must be provisioned, and are APIs available for all of them?
open_questions.impact_if_unanswered: If manual provisioning is required for any tool, success metric 'zero manual tickets' cannot be met (R3 trigger). Backend Developer must know full scope before T13 and T16 implementation to avoid rework.

open_questions.question: Is multi-factor authentication (MFA) required by corporate security policy, or is Azure AD SSO default authentication sufficient?
open_questions.impact_if_unanswered: If MFA is mandated, authentication flow (T6, UC7) must be redesigned, extending Phase 2 by 1-2 weeks (R5 trigger). Backend Developer must confirm MFA requirement before T3 architecture design.

pm_confidence_score.interpretation: PM confidence score is 62.0 because four critical assumptions (data retention, authentication, Workday API, e-signature provider) carry MEDIUM risk_if_wrong, five HIGH-scored risks (R1, R2, R3, R4, R14) directly threaten critical path tasks and success metrics, and Hybrid SDLC requires named Product Owner decision-maker not yet identified. Staffing plan is viable (all roles ≤80%, QA at 28.9% > 25% minimum), but external dependencies (Workday API, e-signature provider, PO assignment) and compliance risk (SOC 2 audit logs) create execution uncertainty. Recommend resolving R1, R2, R3, R4 before Phase 2 kickoff.

project_viability.rationale: Critical path duration = 120 days (24 weeks) vs. deadline 2026-06-30 (26 weeks from 2026-01-01 assumed start). 120 days < 26 weeks × 1.0 (no schedule compression). Estimated cost: 600 total project hours × $150/hour blended rate = $90,000 vs. budget $80,000. Cost overrun = $10,000 (12.5% above budget), which is < 50% threshold (NOT_VIABLE trigger). Project is VIABLE on schedule; cost is slightly above budget but within acceptable variance for Hybrid SDLC with integration risk. Recommend cost mitigation: negotiate fixed-price e-signature provider contract or defer nice-to-have features (R11 scope creep) to Phase 4 post-launch.
